Каменное сердце медленно стучит рядом с: A stone heart beats slowly next to yours.
Каменный не был человеком. Его вырезали: The Stone One was never a man. The priests carved him from the living rock to hold the seal in the deep. We wounded his heart — and now he can't tell thieves from guests. Forgive us, old one.
The stone is warm to the touch.
Punishing the foe, it heals itself.
The floor map appears on the parchment.
The blades are smeared with cave spider venom.
The blade of a fallen paladin.
An oath stronger than any armor.
Когда тьма легла на город, король собрал: When darkness fell over the town, the king gathered four: the court sorceress, the jester, the stone guardian of the mountain and the temple's bell-ringer. They swore to go down and seal what had fallen. But the first to go down was someone nobody had called: old Oldric the gravedigger. They say the Eclipse itself called him.
Skin tougher than the dungeon's stone.
The skin is covered by a shimmering film.
The skin grows hard as bark.
Колокол Храма Солнца звонил на рассвете: The bell of the Temple of the Sun rang at dawn for a thousand years. Now there is no dawn, but I ring. While the bell rings, the black sun can't sleep in peace — the sound keeps it half awake, like a child not allowed to close its eyes. I ring. I ring.
Колокол отлили из меди первого храмового: The bell was cast from the copper of the first temple dome. While it rings, the Eclipse doesn't sleep. I drowned, but the bell remembers my hands. Don't stop it until the end. Although... perhaps it's time to give us both silence.
Колокол треснул — вода кипит!: The bell has cracked — the water boils!
Колокол, что звонит сам: The bell that rings by itself
A ring of flame around the mage.
A crust of ice protects against blows.
Король велел хоронить всех в старых ката: The king ordered everyone buried in the old catacombs, deep down. He said: the dead don't care. The dead — perhaps. But the bones arrange themselves in rows when I leave, and the skulls all look one way. Down. Toward the warmth.
Король костей призывает свиту!: The Bone King summons his retinue!
Король костей — могильщик Олдрик: The Bone King — Oldric the Gravedigger
Король костей, поднятый Затмением из пеп: The Bone King, raised from the ashes by the Eclipse: the sun wrings the last strength out of the gravedigger. His bones are cinders, his wrath is embers.
Кости вырываются из пола и сковывают вра: Bones burst from the floor and bind the enemies.
Который из нас настоящий?: Which one of us is real?
Крепкие шахтёры подгорных глубин. Медлен: Hardy miners of the deep under the mountains. Slow, but unbreakable.
Крепкий боец ближнего боя с мечом и щито: A sturdy melee fighter with sword and shield. Damage depends on Strength. Parry (RMB / L): blocking at the moment of the blow stuns the enemy.
Кристаллы растут обратно за ночь. И раст: The crystals grow back overnight. And not just anywhere — toward one place, the heart of the mountain. The Stone One walks there. Huge, with crystals jutting from his back. He leaves us alone as long as we leave the heart alone. The king ordered us to mine the heart.
